The '''Great Agash sector ''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Its [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] boundary bordered the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], and, moving clockwise, it also bordered the [[Itopol sector/Legends|Itopol]], [[Chitarghar sector/Legends|Chitarghar]], [[Trans-Jardeen sector/Legends|Trans-Jardeen]], [[Extorin sector/Legends|Extorin]], and [[Thand sector/Legends|Thand sectors]]. No major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] passed through the sector.<ref name="EAOC" /> The area within the sector was within space that was considered well-explored by [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], and it was within unaligned space during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] the average population of a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the sector was less than one million.<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Agash system/Legends|Agash system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which contained [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]], the swampy [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ergesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="PGV2" />
